crossRefs.note: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my…
Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.
Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him…
that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.
Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that…
Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.
Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain,
But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.
and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you…

translations.web: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.
translations.bsb: If Timothy comes, see to it that he has nothing to fear while he is with you, for he is doing the work of the Lord, just as I am.
translations.kjv: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.
translations.asv: Now if Timothy come, see that he be with you without fear; for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do:
